course.description: Use AI to pull deals and opportunities from your CRM (HubSpot), analyze them like a VP of Sales for a B2B consulting firm, and build a dashboard with charts, insights, and recommended actions.
learningOutcomes: Apply the methods taught in GTM Strategy Dashboard from CRM Data.

activities.title: Set Up AI with a VP of Sales Persona

lessons.content:
## Configure AI as a VP of Sales Analyst

Give AI the right context so it analyzes your data from a strategic sales leadership perspective.

### Prompt framework:
> You are acting as a VP of Sales for a B2B consulting firm. I am going to provide you with deal/opportunity data from our CRM. Analyze this data and provide:
> - Pipeline health assessment
> - Win rate analysis by segment/source
> - Revenue forecasting insights
> - Strategic recommendations for improving close rates
> - Key risks and opportunities in the current pipeline

### Key details to include:
- What service/product the deals relate to
- Your target market and typical deal cycle
- Any specific KPIs or metrics you care about
- Time period for the analysis
lessons.title: Set Up AI with a VP of Sales Persona

lessons.content:
## Have AI Build Your Dashboard

Turn the analysis into a visual dashboard with charts and actionable insights.

### How to do it:
1. Ask AI to create a dashboard layout with:
   - Pipeline funnel chart (deals by stage)
   - Win rate by source/segment (bar chart)
   - Revenue forecast (line chart)
   - Top deals at risk (table)
2. Use AI to generate the charts — options include:
   - **Claude Artifacts:** Ask Claude to build an interactive HTML/JS dashboard
   - **Python/Matplotlib:** Ask AI to write Python code for static charts
   - **Google Sheets formulas:** Have AI generate formulas and chart configs
3. Include a written analysis section with:
   - Key insights (3-5 bullets)
   - Recommended actions
   - Risks to watch

### Output:
You should have a polished dashboard you can present to leadership showing the GTM strategy health for your new service, with data-backed recommendations.
lessons.title: Build the Dashboard with Charts

lessons.content:
## Upload Data and Get AI Analysis

Feed your CRM export into the AI and let it generate the strategic analysis.

### Steps:
1. Upload your CSV or paste the data into your AI tool (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.)
2. Ask AI to first summarize the dataset — confirm it read the data correctly
3. Then ask for the full analysis based on the VP of Sales persona you set up
4. Review the output for:
   - Pipeline breakdown by stage
   - Win/loss patterns
   - Revenue concentration risks
   - Segment performance comparison

### What to look for:
- Does the analysis match your intuition? If not, dig deeper
- Are there surprising patterns you hadnt noticed?
- What actionable insights can you take to your next sales meeting?
lessons.title: Feed Data and Generate Analysis

lessons.content:
## Export Deals/Opportunities from HubSpot

Start by pulling your deal and opportunity data from your CRM (e.g., HubSpot).

### How to do it:
1. Go to your CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.) and navigate to the Deals/Opportunities section
2. Filter for the specific service or product line you want to analyze
3. Export the data as CSV — include fields like: deal name, stage, amount, close date, owner, source, industry
4. If your CRM has an API, you can have AI pull the data directly using an integration or script

### Pro tip:
The more fields you export, the richer your analysis will be. Include custom fields like deal source, sales cycle length, and win/loss reason if available.
lessons.title: Export Deals from Your CRM
